name: 商品和服务税收分类编码 (sample)

verification.notes: Sample of 19-digit merged codes (合并编码) read directly from the 2017 STA Announcement [2017] No. 45 attachment (~4,205 rows in the source spreadsheet). notes: Do not collapse a later STA rate announcement into this list. The code can outlive the percentage. Local incentives and refund pilots stay out until a citation names them.
